terminal.title: CLAUDE — AKASH@BUILD
terminal.registers: I work in two registers: {automations} (voice agents, ops bots, lead-enrichment pipelines) and {applied ML} (currently LERAGS — a local-only RAG pipeline over scanned court filings).

display: If a human has to do it twice,
I want to know why software isn't.
prose: I trained as a mechanical engineer.
At Eicher Tractors, I watched competent people spend entire days copying numbers between forms.
Crude, but the day got shorter.
At Idea Clan, I saw the same thing again: an editor cutting the same ad, one hook at a time.
So I built Magica to do the repetition.

pull: Find the thing being done twice.

prose: Now I build agents, voice systems and internal tools that remove repetitive work.
currently: LERAGS — local-only RAG over scanned court filings
Voice agents that survive real callers, not scripts
Evaluation harnesses for agents nobody watches
Making LLMs earn their place in a pipeline

timeline.role: Inspector of GST, Department of Revenue

contact.display: Have a process that eats your week?
contact.lede: Tell me the boring version of it — the spreadsheet, the inbox, the phone that keeps ringing. That's usually where the good automation is hiding.
